idea-plugin.name: Erlang
idea-plugin.description:
Erlang support for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, PhpStorm, RubyMine and other JetBrains IDE.

Feel free to file new feature requests as an issue on GitHub.

If you find this plugin useful, consider making a donation to support the project.

The plugin can send anonymous usage counts once a day, only if you allow it. See the privacy policy.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• A spec constraint after when that is not Var :: Type or a subtype call is now marked as a syntax error (#1719)
  • The Run and Debug output of Erlang Application configurations now links to the .erl file and line it names (#1713)
  • A fun argument that hides a variable of another case clause is reported unused and renamed alone (#1711)
  • Unbound variable errors now appear for a match's own right side, recursive anonymous funs and guards (#1707)
  • The Erlang Console reads non-ASCII input such as "å" as one character, whatever locale the IDE was started with (#1712)
  • Empty parentheses where an expression is expected are now marked as a syntax error (#1704)
  • A variable matched again twice in one case clause no longer shows as unused, and Rename updates all of its uses (#1708)
  • and 12 more changes: full list
